underdog.heading: Why Louisiana Tech can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -8.1 to p90 +35.9 for Baylor, so a projection of +14.9 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
